parameters.description: The security question selected by the user. Must match one of the predefined questions in the questions map.

dictionary.What is your favorite animal?: The answer can easily be guessed and figured out through social media.
dictionary.What was the time you were born?: This may first seem like a good question, but you most likely dont know the exact time, so it might be hard to remember.
dictionary.What is the name of the person you first: Can be figured out through social media, or even guessed by trying the most common names.
dictionary.What was the house number and street nam: Answer can be figured out through social media, or worse it might be your current address.
dictionary.In what town or city was your first full: In times of LinkedIn and Facebook, the answer can be figured out quite easily.
dictionary.In what city were you born?: Easy to figure out through social media.
dictionary.What was the last name of your favorite: Most people would probably not know the answer to that.
dictionary.What is the name of a college/job you ap: It might not be easy to remember and an hacker could just try some company's/colleges in your area.
dictionary.What are the last 5 digits of your drive: Is subject to change, and the last digit of your driver license might follow a specific pattern. (For example your birthday).
dictionary.What was your childhood nickname?: Not all people had a nickname.
dictionary.Who was your childhood hero?: Most Heroes we had as a child where quite obvious ones, like Superman for example.
dictionary.On which wrist do you wear your watch?: There are only to possible real answers, so really easy to guess.
